# Acadia Hosts Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony for New Behavioral Health Hospital


Posted on


[August](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2025/08/)[27](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2025/08/27/) ,[2025](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2025/)


by


[Acadia Healthcare](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/author/acadia-healthcare)


On August 25, a ribbon-cutting ceremony was held to celebrate the upcoming opening of ECU Health Behavioral Health Hospital in Greenville, North Carolina. The state-of-the-art, 144-bed hospital will offer inpatient and intensive outpatient treatment for children, adolescents, adults, and senior adults.
